App Store page coming soon

Free to download. The free demo is one House race, up to your first election night; the full game is a one-time $4.99 purchase.

The game

You are a non-violent, mind-controlling alien parasite. Your enemy: democracy. Start in any real American town (your hometown, if you like) and take over the organizations that sway it: the diner, the church, the bank, the sheriff's office.

Each organization is a hex board. Assimilate anyone open-minded enough to fall under your control, and push out those too entrenched for it to stick.

Around the boards runs a real election, simulated down to the town and the party. Run a candidate for the House, then the Senate, then the White House.

Screenshots

Features

  • Assimilation as a board game: the organizations and social clubs that sway voters are hex boards, taken one person at a time, with showdowns over who leads them.
  • Debate and interview minigames: dodge the tough questions and swipe to as many talking points as you can.
  • The press and the FBI fight back: undercover agents and investigative reporters turn up on the boards.
  • Name your party and set its platform, siding with red, with blue, or dodging the question on issues that change how voters react to you.
  • House, Senate and presidential races on the real election calendar. The free demo is one House race, up to your first election night.
